onMyOwn.explain: Why does Omar's way not work?

onMyOwn.modelExplanation: 2{3/4} is one amount. It must divide all of 5{1/2}, not one part at a time. Change first: {11/2} × {4/11} = 2. Check: 2 × 2{3/4} = 5{1/2}.
onMyOwn.modelExplanationEs: 2{3/4} es una sola cantidad. Debe dividir todo 5{1/2}, no una parte a la vez. Primero convierte: {11/2} × {4/11} = 2. Comprobación: 2 × 2{3/4} = 5{1/2}.
